title: Letter & Report On A.K. Wu And D. Harvards Whereabouts

page_data.en:
May 27 31.

Dear Steptoe,

With reference to your letter dated
May 20, 1931, the addresses, No. 45 Green Yard,
Scott Road, and No. 254 Peking Road, do not
exist and the whereabouts of the persons named
A.K. Wu and D. Harvard cannot be traced.
Green Yard is now enumerated from Nos. 1 to 10 -
the old numbers were 212-222 - and all the houses
are occupied by employees of the Y...C.A. There
is a house No. 45 in Venhwa Terrace off Scott
Road. This is a new building, and has been
occupied only about a week.

Yours sincerely,

H.R. Steptoe, Esq.,
H.B.M. Consulate-General.
page_data.zh:
1931年5月27日。

亲爱的斯蒂普托：

关于您1931年5月20日的来信，斯科特路（Scott Road）格林院（Green Yard）45号及北京路（Peking Road）254号这两个地址均不存在，且无法查明名为A.K. Wu和D. Harvard之人的下落。格林院目前的门牌号为1至10号（旧门牌号为212-222号），所有房屋均由基督教青年会（Y...C.A.）的雇员居住。斯科特路旁的文华邨（Venhwa Terrace）有一处45号房屋。这是一栋新建筑，入住仅约一周。

此致

敬礼

H.R. 斯蒂普托 先生，
英国驻上海总领事馆。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / FILED / S. L. D. 2100 / S. 2. 317 5. 3 Station / Date May 27, 1931）

Subject (in full) Attached letter.

Made by D.S. Moore. Forwarded by WhOuncan D.S.P.

Sir,

Re the attached letter from Mr. N.
Steptoe which is the outcome of the arrest in England of one
Sing Chi Liao, a member of the International Seamen's Club at
Rotterdam.

Enquiries show that (1) No. 45 of either
Green Yard or Scott Road does not exist and that A.K. Wu is
unknown in that locality. Green Yard is enumerated from Nos.
1 to 10 (old enumeration 212-222), all the houses being occupied
by employees of the Y.M.C.A. No. 5 house is occupied by one
Ng Yao Chun and his wife Yang Soo Zai, a doctor. No. 45 Venhwa
Terrace off Scott Road is newly constructed and its first
occupant, Eu Fah Daung, only took possession about a week ago.
Also covering (2), there is no such number as 254 Peking Road
and the person D. Harvard is unknown to the Municipal Police.

（批：HR）

W. S. Moore
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 归档 / S. L. D. 2100 / S. 2. 317 5. 3 分局 / 日期 1931年5月27日）

事由（全称）附信。

由 D.S. 穆尔拟写。由 WhOuncan 副总巡捕转发。

先生，

关于附上的N. 斯蒂普托先生的来信，该信源于在英格兰逮捕了一名名叫廖星池（Sing Chi Liao）的人，此人是鹿特丹国际海员俱乐部的成员。

经查，(1) 无论是格林院还是斯科特路均无45号这一门牌，且在该地区无人知晓A.K. Wu其人。格林院的门牌号为1至10号（旧门牌号212-222号），所有房屋均由基督教青年会（Y.M.C.A.）的雇员居住。5号房屋由吴耀春（Ng Yao Chun）及其妻子、医生杨素哉（Yang Soo Zai）居住。斯科特路旁文华邨（Venhwa Terrace）的45号系新建，其首位住户欧法当（Eu Fah Daung，音译）于约一周前才入住。关于(2)，北京路并无254号这一门牌，且工部局警务处不知晓D. Harvard其人。

（批注：HR）

W. S. 穆尔
副巡捕

特别部门主管警官。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. U. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2440.
ue 20 - 5 - 31
May 20th 1931.

Dear Givens,

I have received information that a certain
Chinese named SING CHI LIAO who is a member of the
International Seemens' Club at Rotterdam, has been
arrested b the authorities at Home and certain letters
of an incriminating nature were found on him addressed
to:
1) A.K.Wu, 45 Green Yard, Scott Road, Shanghai, and
2) D.Harvard, 254 Peking Road, Shanghai.
Can you possibly trace these addresses and let me have
a report on the two persons in question if they exist.

（左侧竖排手写字：From A. M. Stokoe.）
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记处
编号 S. B. D. 2440。
ue 20 - 5 - 31
1931年5月20日。

亲爱的吉文斯：

我获悉，一名名叫廖星池（SING CHI LIAO）的中国人，系鹿特丹国际海员俱乐部（International Seemens' Club）成员，已被本国当局逮捕，并在其身上发现了若干封具有指控性质的信件，收件人地址为：
1) A.K.Wu，上海斯科特路格林院45号，以及
2) D.Harvard，上海北京路254号。
能否请您追查这些地址，如果确有其人，请就这两名相关人员向我提交一份报告。

（左侧竖排手写字：来自 A. M. Stokoe。）
